chunks: An Apostle from God, reading out hallowed pages
ai.seo_question: Who is the messenger reciting the purified pages in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) or the Imams as the bearers of the pristine, uncorrupted divine revelation, contrasting with the textual alterations found in previous scriptures. The term 'Suhuf Mutahharah' (Pure Scrolls) underscores the theological concept of *Ismah* (infallibility) and the preservation of the Quran from any human interference or distortion.
